tools.description: For trained camera reviewers only: how many camera observations are waiting for review. A count and nothing else; the observations themselves are reviewed on the Camera review screen. Read-only.

tools.name: list_my_outpasses
tools.description: The caller's own (a student's) or own children's (a parent's) hostel out-passes and where each stands. Read-only.

tools.name: list_outpasses
tools.description: Hostel out-passes for the warden: waiting for a decision (default), approved, out now, overdue back, or all. Read-only.

tools.name: request_outpass
tools.description: Request a hostel out-pass (e.g. "request an out-pass for my son on Saturday 10 am to Sunday 6 pm to go home"). A parent's request goes straight to the warden; a student's first goes to their guardian. Needs confirmation.

childName.description: A parent's child; a student requests for themselves

tools.name: cancel_outpass
tools.description: Cancel an own (or own child's) out-pass that has not been used yet. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_outpass_consent
tools.description: For a parent: record their own consent (APPROVED) or refusal (REJECTED) for an out-pass their child asked for. Only when the parent says so themselves. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_outpass_decision
tools.description: For the warden: record their own decision on an out-pass waiting for them — APPROVED, or REJECTED with the reason. Only when the warden says so in their own words; never suggested. The guardians are told. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_outpass_gate
tools.description: Record a resident leaving (EXIT, on an approved out-pass) or coming back (RETURN) at the gate by hand; a late return alerts the wardens. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_staff_leave_balance
tools.description: Leave balance for this leave year (April–March): entitled, carried forward, used, pending and available per leave type. The caller's own by default; HR and the principal may name a colleague. Read-only.

tools.name: list_staff_leave
tools.description: Staff leave applications: the caller's own, or — for HR and the principal — everyone's (pending by default for them), optionally on a date or for one colleague. Read-only.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, who is on leave that day

tools.name: apply_staff_leave
tools.description: Apply for the caller's own staff leave (e.g. "apply for casual leave on Monday because of a family function"): type, dates (or a half day), reason. The draft shows the working days it counts and the balance left. HR and the principal are told. Needs confirmation.

type.description: CL casual, SL sick, EL earned, ML maternity, PL paternity, DL duty, LWP without pay

tools.name: cancel_staff_leave
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's own pending leave, or cancel an approved leave that has not started (its balance is restored and cover for the days ahead is cancelled). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_staff_leave_decision
tools.description: For HR and the principal: record their own decision on a colleague's pending leave — APPROVE (the balance is deducted) or REJECT with the reason. Only when the approver says so in their own words; never suggested. Nobody decides their own leave. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_cover_arrangements
tools.description: Substitute cover on a day (default today): who is covering which class and period in place of whom (e.g. "who is covering 7B period 3"), or with mine=true the covers the caller is taking. Read-only.

tools.name: get_cover_needs
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: who is away on a day (default today) — on approved leave or marked absent — and which of their periods still need cover. Absence reasons are not given. Read-only.

tools.name: suggest_cover_teachers
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: the best substitutes for one class and period on a day — free then, in school, within the cover limits; same subject and same class first — and who cannot and why. Read-only; nobody is assigned.

tools.name: assign_cover
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: confirm a named teacher as the substitute for one class and period (e.g. "assign Ms Rao to cover 8C period 2"). Refused when they are busy then; going over the cover limit needs a reason. The absent teacher, the substitute and the class are told. Confirmed on the website.

overrideReason.description: Only to go over the cover limit

tools.name: cancel_cover
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: cancel a confirmed cover for a class and period, with the reason. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: mark_staff_absent
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: mark a colleague absent for a day (an unplanned absence) so their lessons show as needing cover. Loss of pay is a payroll input and is set on the Cover screen, not here. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_analytics_overview
tools.description: The analytics workspace in words: the headline figures (or one department's) for a period — this month, quarter, year, academic or financial year — with the change against the previous period or last year, and how complete each figure is. Within the caller's own departments or classes. The CSV is downloaded on the Analytics screen. Read-only.

department.description: e.g. finance, academics, admissions, people, facilities, procurement; default all (headlines)

tools.name: list_quarterly_reports
tools.description: The quarterly decision reports addressed to the caller: each quarter and version, its status and when it was generated. Read-only.

tools.name: get_quarterly_report
tools.description: One quarterly report (the latest by default, or e.g. "FY2026-27-Q2"): the summary figures with their change on the prior quarter and last year, limited to the sections the caller receives. The PDF is downloaded on the Reports screen. Read-only.

tools.name: regenerate_quarterly_report
tools.description: Generate a new version of a quarterly report (the previous quarter by default) from the live records, with the reason. Earlier versions stay as they were. It is NOT sent: distribution to the recipients is done on the Reports screen. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: build_dashboard_panel
tools.description: Builds a dashboard panel for a question in words — "compare fee collection this year with last year by month", "show attendance for 7B this term", "my child's homework" — from the analytics workspace (within the caller's own departments or classes) or the caller's own dashboard. Returns the figures with their period and comparison; the website shows them as a chart panel. Read-only.

question.description: What to show, in words, e.g. "attendance for 7B this term"

tools.name: list_pinned_panels
tools.description: The generated panels the caller has pinned to their Analytics page and dashboard. Read-only.

tools.name: pin_dashboard_panel
tools.description: Pins a question as a panel on the caller's own Analytics page or dashboard, rebuilt from live figures each time it is shown, e.g. "pin fee collection this year by month to my analytics". Only the caller sees it. Needs confirmation.

question.description: What to show, in words, e.g. "attendance for 7B this term"

surface.description: analytics (the Analytics page) or dashboard (the home dashboard); default analytics

tools.name: unpin_dashboard_panel
tools.description: Removes one of the caller's pinned panels, named by its title or question. Needs confirmation.

title.description: Words from the panel's title or question

tools.name: get_health_visits_today
tools.description: School nurse only: today's health-room visits (who, time in/out, complaint, outcome) and the medicine doses due today with what has been given. Read-only; every read is audited.

tools.name: get_child_medication_log
tools.description: A parent: the medication log for their own child at school (each dose given, missed or refused, when and by whom). The school nurse may ask for any student. Read-only; every read is audited.

childName.description: The child, e.g. "Rahul". A parent with one child may leave it out.

tools.name: log_health_visit
tools.description: School nurse only: record a health-room visit (student, complaint, what was done, outcome: returned to class, rest, first aid, sent home or referred; injury or medicine given). Parents are told for the outcomes the school chose. Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: The student, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

notifyParent.description: Tell the parents even when the outcome is not one the school notifies by default

tools.name: log_medicine_dose
tools.description: School nurse only: record a scheduled medicine dose from a consented plan as given, missed or refused (student and the dose time, e.g. 12:30). A controlled medicine then waits for a second person's countersignature on the Health page. Confirmed on the website only.

tools.name: get_campus_moment
tools.description: What is happening on campus at a moment: whether the school is open (holiday, weekly off, vacation, closure, exam-only day), each shift's bell (arrival, assembly, period N of M and minutes left, break, lunch, dispersal, clubs), which classes are in which rooms or out on the ground or in the canteen, buses arriving/parked/departing, and when the school next opens. Staff may give any date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (HH:MM, school time); parents and students get now, with numbers for their own child's class only. Read-only; nobody is located.

date.description: A date, e.g. "2026-10-16". Staff only; default today.

time.description: A school time, e.g. "13:30". Staff only; default now.

tools.name: get_section_shift
tools.description: Which shift a class is in (e.g. "7B", "Class 7 B"), with that shift's days and bell schedule (arrival, assembly, periods, breaks, lunch, dispersal). Parents and students may ask about their own child's class. Read-only.

className.description: The class, e.g. "7B" or "Class 7 B"

tools.name: get_teacher_qualifications
tools.description: A teacher's professional profile: qualifications (degree, institution, year), subjects and specialisations, years of experience, certifications (e.g. CTET) and short bio. Staff see a colleague's record; parents and students see only what the teacher has agreed to show families, and only for teachers of their own child's class. Read-only.

tools.name: sync_ad_data
tools.description: Sync ad data now: pull daily campaign spend, impressions, clicks, leads and conversions from the school's connected ad accounts (Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn) for a date range (default the last 7 days). Re-syncing replaces those days, never doubles them. A platform that is not connected is reported as such (nothing is fetched; its figures come from CSV imports). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_ad_campaign_performance
tools.description: How ad campaigns did over a period ("how did the Meta campaign do last week"): spend, impressions, clicks, platform-reported leads, cost per lead and CTR per platform campaign, from the live sync or imported CSV exports, plus when each platform was last synced. Simulated sample rows are labelled. Read-only.

campaign.description: Words from the campaign name or its code, e.g. "ADM27" or "open day"

tools.name: share_news_to_social
tools.description: Post a published, public newsroom story to the school's social accounts on the networks the staff member names ("post this news to Facebook and LinkedIn"), only at their explicit request. Every pictured child's public consent is checked again first. Each network is posted at most once per story; networks whose account is connected are posted for real, others are recorded as Simulated — not posted; YouTube community posts are not supported by YouTube's API. Confirmed on the website only.

story.description: Words from the story title; default the latest published public story

tools.name: get_school_attendance_overview
tools.description: School-wide attendance for the principal: each class's percentage over a period (default the last 30 days), the school's overall figure, today's registers not yet taken, and how many students are below the attendance threshold (default 75%, the CBSE board-exam line) with the lowest ones named. Read-only.

tools.name: get_teacher_workload
tools.description: Teaching load from the timetable: periods a week per teacher (and per day), classes and subjects, class-teacher duty, cover taken in the last 30 days and leave this year, with teachers over a cap (default 30 periods a week) flagged. Name a teacher to see just them. Read-only.

tools.name: get_board_pack
tools.description: The board pack for a governance meeting (by title or MTG reference; default the next meeting): agenda, previous minutes and resolutions, open actions, finance and budget figures, compliance exceptions, decisions waiting for trustees, and suggested questions each tied to the figure behind it. Members see the frozen version the secretariat circulated (opening it records a read receipt). Read-only.

tools.name: list_board_actions
tools.description: Open actions from governance meetings (board, SMC, committees) you can see, with owner and due date, overdue first. Read-only.

tools.name: schedule_board_meeting
tools.description: Schedule a meeting of the trust board, School Management Committee or a committee on a date and time, inviting the named members (default: every trustee and the principal). Members are notified. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: set_board_agenda
tools.description: Set a meeting's agenda (items in order; mark those needing a decision), and optionally circulate it to members. Replaces a draft agenda; a circulated agenda is changed on the Governance screen. Needs confirmation.

circulate.description: Send the agenda to members now

tools.name: freeze_board_pack
tools.description: Freeze the board pack for a meeting as a new version, so every member reads the same papers (their opens are recorded). The figures are taken from the records as they stand now. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: respond_to_board_meeting
tools.description: Answer an invitation to a governance meeting you are a member of: accepted, tentative or declined. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: declare_meeting_conflict
tools.description: Declare a conflict of interest on an agenda item of a meeting you are a member of (e.g. a relative owns the vendor). You stay recorded as present but do not vote on that item. Adds to any declarations you made before. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: mark_board_action_done
tools.description: Mark an open board action done (its owner, or the secretariat for any action). Name the action. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_certificate_requests
tools.description: School office: certificate requests (transfer, bonafide, character, fee …) waiting to be reviewed or ready to generate, newest first. Filter by status or student. Read-only.

tools.name: get_certificate_clearance
tools.description: No-dues check for a student's certificate request: fees outstanding, library books not returned or fines due, a hostel bed still allotted. A transfer or leaving certificate needs all clear. Read-only.

studentName.description: The student the certificate is for

tools.name: generate_certificate
tools.description: Generate the certificate for an APPROVED request from the student's record (particulars, date of birth in words, first admission, last class, attendance, fee position) with a serial number and verification code, and attach it to the request so the family can download it. A transfer or leaving certificate is refused while dues are open unless you give the reason to issue anyway. Office details such as reason for leaving and conduct are optional. Confirmed on the website only.

studentName.description: The student the certificate is for

overrideReason.description: Only if dues are open and the school has decided to issue anyway: the reason, in the user's words

tools.name: list_issued_certificates
tools.description: The register of certificates generated by the office (serial number, student, date, who issued, whether dues were open). Read-only.

tools.name: check_certificate_code
tools.description: Check a certificate's verification code (printed at the foot of certificates the office generated) against the register. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fee_collections
tools.description: Fee collections for a date range (default this month): total received, refunds and net, by mode (cash, UPI, card, cheque), by day, by cashier, by fee category and by class, and receipts not yet confirmed. E.g. "collection today by mode", "how much cash did we take this week".

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default the 1st of this month

tools.name: get_fee_ageing
tools.description: Overdue fees per student in ageing buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days past due), with the oldest due date, the last payment and whether the family is on a fee plan. Optional bucket or class filter.

className.description: e.g. "Class 8 B"

tools.name: get_fee_receipt_flags
tools.description: Audit flags on fee receipts for a date range, each with the receipts behind it: the same UTR or cheque number used twice, cash at or above the s.269ST ₹2 lakh limit, counter entries out of hours or on Sundays, back-dated entries, large round cash, and cash keyed after the day was closed. Prompts to look, not findings.

tools.name: get_cash_position
tools.description: The counter cash for a day (default today): cash received less cash refunds, which the drawer should hold, the other modes taken, and whether the day has been closed and checked.

tools.name: close_cash_day
tools.description: Close the counter for a day with the notes and coins counted (e.g. "500 x 12, 200 x 5, 100 x 3"), the opening float and an explanation if the count does not match. A second person then checks it on the website. Confirmed on the website only.

openingFloatRupees.description: Cash kept in the drawer from before

note.description: Why the count differs, if it does

tools.name: send_fee_reminders
tools.description: Send the standard fee reminder ("A fee payment is due on <date>. Please check the Payments page") to the guardians of overdue students, chosen by ageing bucket, class or minimum days overdue. Families on an approved fee plan are left out unless asked; each family gets at most one reminder a week. Shows who will receive it first; confirmed on the website only.

tools.name: get_payroll_run
tools.description: One payroll run (by reference, e.g. PAY/2026/0004, or month "2026-09"; default the run in draft): status, totals, headcount and warnings; with payroll access, each employee's gross, deductions and net.

tools.name: update_payroll_inputs
tools.description: Enter one employee's loss-of-pay days and/or arrears on the payroll run in draft (other employees' inputs are kept). Nobody can put arrears on their own line. Recalculate afterwards. Confirmed on the website only.

tools.name: calculate_payroll_run
tools.description: Recalculate the payroll run in draft (or the one named) from the pay structures, the statutory rules and the inputs. It does not send it for approval.

tools.name: get_staff_leave_balances
tools.description: Every staff member's leave balances this leave year (CL, SL, EL and others): entitled, used and available. Optional name filter.

tools.name: get_staff_leave_lop
tools.description: Loss-of-pay days per staff member for a month (approved unpaid leave and absences marked LOP, on working days), ready for the payroll run.

tools.name: list_verification_cases
tools.description: Background-verification cases (staff, drivers, vendors) with their status and the checks still open. Optional status: INITIATED, IN_PROGRESS, HR_REVIEW, AWAITING_DECISION, CLEARED, NOT_CLEARED, EXPIRED.

tools.name: list_recruitment_vacancies
tools.description: Vacancies with how many candidates are at each stage (applied, screened, demo lesson, interview, offered, accepted, joined).

tools.name: open_vacancy
tools.description: Open a vacancy: post title, department, subject, positions, qualifications (e.g. "B.Ed, CTET"), salary band and closing date. Child-facing posts (the default) need background verification before joining.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Candidates, optionally for one vacancy or at one stage, with their average interview score and verification status.

tools.name: add_candidate
tools.description: Add an applicant to an open vacancy: name, email, phone, source (referral, portal, walk-in), years of experience, qualifications, expected CTC and notice period.

tools.name: move_candidate
tools.description: Move a candidate to the next stage: SCREENED, DEMO_LESSON, INTERVIEW, OFFERED (needs the offer drafted), ACCEPTED, JOINED (a child-facing post needs cleared verification), REJECTED (with a reason) or WITHDRAWN.

tools.name: add_candidate_scorecard
tools.description: Add your interview scorecard for a candidate, 1-5 on subject knowledge, teaching method, communication, classroom management, child safeguarding awareness and values/fit, with a recommendation (STRONG_YES, YES, MAYBE, NO).

tools.name: draft_offer_letter
tools.description: Draft the offer letter for a candidate from the vacancy and the CTC and joining date given; saved on the candidate for HR to edit, print and sign. Nothing is sent.

tools.name: list_staff_exits
tools.description: Open staff exits (resignations, retirements, contract ends): last working day, notice served, department clearances pending and whether the full-and-final has gone to payroll.

tools.name: start_staff_exit
tools.description: Start a staff member's exit: the kind (RESIGNATION, RETIREMENT, TERMINATION, CONTRACT_END, DEATH), the notice date, the last working day, the notice period required and the departments to clear (ACADEMICS, LIBRARY, IT, ACCOUNTS, ADMIN, TRANSPORT, LABS, HOSTEL). Not your own. Confirmed on the website only.

tools.name: update_exit_clearance
tools.description: Record a department's clearance for a leaving staff member: CLEARED, or DUES with the amount or what is outstanding (e.g. two library books).

tools.name: estimate_full_and_final
tools.description: Work out a leaving staff member's full-and-final worksheet: gratuity (15/26 × basic+DA × years, after 5 years), earned-leave encashment, notice-period recovery and clearance dues. Saved on the exit for HR; it pays nothing.

elDays.description: Earned-leave days to encash; default the balance on file

tools.name: get_health_watchlist
tools.description: School nurse only: the watch list from the health-room records: possible clusters (3+ children in one class with a similar complaint within a few days), children seen 4+ times in 30 days, immunisations due or overdue, and screening coverage by class with follow-ups. Prompts, not diagnoses; every read is audited.

tools.name: list_health_visits
tools.description: School nurse only: health-room visits for a date range, a student or an outcome (complaint, outcome, time in and out, whether the parents were told). Every read is audited.

tools.name: close_health_visit
tools.description: School nurse only: finish today's open visit for a student: the time out (default now), and optionally a changed outcome or what was done. Parents are told if the new outcome is one the school notifies.

tools.name: list_health_stock
tools.description: School nurse only: first-aid stock, medicines and equipment with quantity, reorder level and expiry; which are low, expiring or expired.

tools.name: update_health_stock
tools.description: School nurse only: set the quantity on hand of a stock item after a count or a delivery (and optionally the new expiry date or batch).

tools.name: add_health_entry
tools.description: School nurse only: add an immunisation (vaccine, dose number, where given, next dose due) or a screening (height cm, weight kg, vision e.g. 6/6, dental, hearing, remarks) to a student's health card.

tools.name: get_library_desk_briefing
tools.description: The librarian's briefing: overdue loans (and how many are two weeks late), reservations waiting on the hold shelf and in queues, fines not settled, last 30 days' circulation and idle titles. Each line is a count from the records.

tools.name: list_overdue_loans
tools.description: Overdue library loans: book, student, class, due date, days late, the fine so far and whether a reminder went today.

tools.name: send_library_overdue_reminders
tools.description: Remind every overdue borrower (the student and their guardians) to return their book. At most once a day per loan; those already reminded today are skipped. Confirmed on the website.

minDaysLate.description: Only loans at least this many days late (default 1)

tools.name: renew_library_loan
tools.description: Renew a student's loan by 7 days (or the days asked, up to 30). At most 2 renewals; an overdue loan, or one another student is waiting for with no other copy, cannot be renewed.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: reserve_library_book
tools.description: Place a reservation for a student on a book. With a copy on the shelf it is set aside at once (the family is told); otherwise the student joins the queue and gets the next returned copy.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: list_library_reservation_queue
tools.description: Open reservations: READY ones on the hold shelf (with the date they expire) and QUEUED ones with each student's place in the queue. Optionally for one book.

tools.name: cancel_library_reservation
tools.description: Cancel a student's reservation on a book; a copy that was set aside passes to the next in line.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: lend_reserved_book
tools.description: The student is at the desk to collect a book set aside for them: turn the READY reservation into a loan (default a fortnight).

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: list_unpaid_library_fines
tools.description: Library fines not yet settled (book, student, amount, returned on) and the total. Read-only: a fine is marked paid or waived at the desk.

tools.name: get_library_insights
tools.description: Library circulation insights for a period (default 90 days): loans, active readers and share of students, on-time return rate, most borrowed titles, loans by category and by class, titles idle for a year.

tools.name: suggest_books_for_student
tools.description: Next-read suggestions for a student, each with its reasons (categories they borrow, what classmates borrow, copies on the shelf). Never repeats a book they have borrowed. A suggestion for the librarian, not a decision.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: create_reading_challenge
tools.description: Start a reading challenge, e.g. "Read 5 books this term" for some classes (or the whole school), optionally only certain categories. Books borrowed and returned in the window count.

sectionIds.description: Sections taking part; omit for every student

tools.name: get_reading_challenge_progress
tools.description: Progress in a reading challenge: participants, how many have started and completed, and each student's books read. Name the challenge, or leave it out for the latest active one.

tools.name: get_hostel_night_briefing
tools.description: The warden's briefing: residents, how many are away on an out-pass, dinners to cook, the last roll call (present, not accounted for), out-passes past their return time or waiting for a decision, open incidents.

tools.name: start_hostel_roll_call
tools.description: Open tonight's (or a given date's) NIGHT or MORNING roll call for all residents or one block. Residents out on an out-pass are pre-marked on leave; returns the one already open if there is one.

tools.name: get_hostel_roll_call
tools.description: A roll call (default tonight's NIGHT one): counts and each resident with room and status, including who is still unmarked.

tools.name: mark_hostel_roll_call
tools.description: Mark residents on the open roll call: name each with PRESENT, ON_LEAVE, LATE, SICK_BAY or ABSENT, and/or allPresent to mark everyone still unmarked present. After submission only a missing resident can be marked LATE (arrived).

tools.name: submit_hostel_roll_call
tools.description: Submit the roll call. Anyone still unmarked or absent counts as not accounted for: every warden and the principal are alerted and an urgent task opens until each is found. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_mess_menu
tools.description: The hostel mess menu for a week (default this week): breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner each day, and tonight's headcount.

tools.name: update_mess_menu
tools.description: Set the mess menu for one day (any of breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner); the rest of the week is kept.

tools.name: log_hostel_incident
tools.description: Record a hostel incident or discipline note: residents involved (by name), category, severity, what happened and what was done. A HIGH one opens a follow-up task. A safeguarding concern must also be reported on the Safeguarding page (say referredToSafeguarding).

tools.name: list_hostel_incidents
tools.description: Hostel incidents (default open ones): reference, residents, category, severity, when, and how many times the family was contacted. Optionally for one resident.

tools.name: log_parent_contact
tools.description: Record that you spoke to a family about a hostel incident (call, WhatsApp, meeting or email) and what was said. The assistant does not contact them; it records the conversation you had.

tools.name: resolve_hostel_incident
tools.description: Close a hostel incident with how it was resolved.

tools.name: get_followup_queue
tools.description: Today's admission follow-ups: overdue (next action passed), due today, never contacted after the first-response window, and enquiries with no next action. Each with an explained warmth score (HOT/WARM/COLD) and do-not-contact flags. mine=true for only your own enquiries.

tools.name: get_enquiry_score
tools.description: The warmth score of one admission enquiry (0-100, HOT/WARM/COLD) with every reason behind it, from the record: stage, recency of contact, visits, consent, how its source converts, seats left. Explains; decides nothing.

tools.name: log_admission_followup
tools.description: Record a follow-up on an admission enquiry: how (call, WhatsApp, email, visit or a note), what was said, the next action date, and optionally the new stage (LOST needs a reason). A new enquiry moves to CONTACTED. Refused for a family that withdrew consent to be contacted (a note is still allowed).

tools.name: get_counsellor_stats
tools.description: Per counsellor over a period (default 90 days): enquiries, open, overdue follow-ups, enrolled, lost, conversion and median first-response hours.

tools.name: list_counselling_appointments
tools.description: Upcoming counselling appointments, campus tours, interviews and entrance tests (mine=true for only yours).

tools.name: create_counselling_appointment
tools.description: Book a counselling session, campus tour, interview, entrance test, call or document check for an enquiry, with you as the counsellor. A campus tour moves a new enquiry to TOUR_SCHEDULED. Refused if you already have an appointment then.

tools.name: list_marketing_campaigns
tools.description: Marketing campaigns: name, code, objective, channels, dates, status, budget and spend, and enquiries attributed.

tools.name: create_marketing_campaign
tools.description: Create a marketing campaign (name, short code used on links and QR codes, objective, channels, dates, budget in rupees, grades). It records the plan; no money is spent and nothing is posted.

tools.name: get_admission_capacity
tools.description: Seats per grade for the intake: capacity, offered, accepted, available and utilisation.

tools.name: get_compliance_readiness
tools.description: The compliance readiness checklist: CBSE safety certificates on file and in date (fire, building, water, health and sanitation, affiliation), required committees (POCSO, ICC, safety, SMC, grievance), data requests answered in time, breaches reported within 72 hours, training coverage. Each line says what was found and where to act; OK means a record exists, not that the school is compliant.

tools.name: list_data_requests
tools.description: DPDP data-principal requests (default open ones): reference, kind (access, correction, erasure, consent withdrawal, grievance, nomination), requester, response date, days left, overdue.

tools.name: log_data_request
tools.description: Log a data-principal request received under the DPDP Act (by letter, email or at the office): kind, who asked (for a child, the parent), contact and details. It gets a reference, a response date (30 days by default) and a task.

tools.name: update_data_request
tools.description: Move a data request on: mark the requester's identity verified, start work, or close it as COMPLETED or DECLINED with the outcome in words (what was given, corrected or erased, or why not). Completing needs identity verified.

tools.name: list_data_breaches
tools.description: The personal-data breach register: each breach with when it was discovered, people affected (and whether children), status, and the 72-hour Board-report clock (hours left or overdue).

tools.name: log_data_breach
tools.description: Log a personal-data breach the moment you learn of it: what happened, when it was discovered, data involved, how many people, whether children. Starts the 72-hour clock for the detailed report to the Data Protection Board and a critical task. Nothing is sent to the Board from here. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: update_data_breach
tools.description: Record what was done on a breach: containment, when the Board was intimated, when the detailed report went, when the people affected were informed, the count, or the status (CONTAINED / CLOSED; closing needs the report recorded). Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_statutory_committees
tools.description: Statutory committees (POCSO, ICC/POSH, school safety, SMC, grievance, anti-bullying, disaster management): members, constitution and review dates, whether displayed on the website and notice board.

tools.name: save_statutory_committee
tools.description: Record a statutory committee, or update the existing one of that kind: members (name, role, phone), constituted on, review due, last meeting, displayed on the website / notice board. A review date becomes a task.

tools.name: get_training_coverage
tools.description: Mandatory training coverage by topic (POCSO, POSH, fire safety, first aid, data protection, ...): staff covered in the renewal window and the percentage.

tools.name: schedule_compliance_training
tools.description: Schedule a training session (POCSO, POSH, fire safety, first aid, emergency drill, data protection, ...) for an audience; everyone in it is invited in the app. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_family_today
tools.description: A parent's day across all their children at once: today's attendance mark for each child, homework due in the next few days, fees outstanding, the next exam, and everything waiting for the parent (fees past due, club consent, hostel out-pass, health-room consent, PTM slot to book, unread teacher messages). Use for 'how are my kids today', 'anything I need to do', 'good morning'. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fee_tax_statement
tools.description: For a parent: the fees paid to the school in one Indian financial year (April to March), per child, split into tuition and other charges, with receipt numbers. Tuition is what Section 80C of the Income-tax Act allows (up to two children). Use for 'tuition fee for tax', '80C', 'fees paid last year'. Read-only.

financialYear.description: e.g. "2025-26"; the current year when left out

childName.description: One child only; all children when left out

tools.name: translate_school_notice
tools.description: A school notice (announcement) put into the reader's language by the AI service, e.g. 'explain the latest circular in Hindi'. Picks the notice by words from its title, or the latest one. The English notice remains the official one and is shown beside it. Read-only.

notice.description: Words from the notice title; the latest notice when left out

language.description: e.g. Hindi, Marathi, Tamil; the language set in your message preferences when left out

tools.name: get_child_growth_view
tools.description: For a parent: their child's growth score this month, the same transparent figure the Student View page shows (60% published marks, 40% attendance), with each part explained. Never compared with other children. Read-only.

childName.description: For a parent with several children

tools.name: set_my_message_preferences
tools.description: Change how the school contacts you: the language for school messages (e.g. Hindi), WhatsApp updates on or off, and quiet hours (no non-urgent messages between two hours). Needs confirmation.

whatsappUpdates.description: true to receive WhatsApp updates, false to stop them

tools.name: list_lesson_plans
tools.description: A teacher's lesson plans for a day or range (default this week): date, class, subject, title, status (draft, ready, taught) and the ones from past days not yet marked taught. The principal sees every teacher's. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: get_lesson_plan_suggestion
tools.description: A suggested lesson plan for one of the teacher's classes, built from the syllabus module's next untaught topics, the subject's usual NEP pedagogies and a competency-based question from the bank when there is one (5E steps with minutes, objectives, differentiation, exit check, homework). Nothing is saved: the teacher edits it and saves it with save_lesson_plan.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: save_lesson_plan
tools.description: Save a lesson plan for one of the teacher's classes on a date: by default the suggested plan (from the syllabus module), with any of the teacher's own title, objectives, steps, pedagogies, competency check or homework replacing the suggestion. Saved as DRAFT (or READY). Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

ready.description: Save as READY instead of DRAFT

useSuggestion.description: Start from the suggested plan (default true)

tools.name: mark_lesson_taught
tools.description: Mark one of the teacher's lesson plans taught: the planned topics are ticked in the syllabus tracker, the reflection is kept, and (with homeworkDueOn) the plan's homework is set as a real assignment for the class. Identify the plan by date, class/subject or title. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

reflection.description: How it went, what to revisit

homeworkDueOn.description: Set the homework as an assignment due this day

tools.name: add_lesson_plan_feedback
tools.description: The principal or a coordinator: add a feedback note to a teacher's lesson plan (identified by date, class/subject or title). The note never changes the plan or its status. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: search_question_bank
tools.description: Questions in the school's question bank for a subject and class the caller teaches: chapter, type (MCQ, case-based, short answer...), marks, cognitive level and whether competency-based. Filter by chapter, type or competency-based only. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: add_bank_question
tools.description: Add a question to the school's shared question bank for a subject and class the caller teaches: chapter, type, marks, the question, options (MCQ / assertion-reason, with the correct one), answer or marking scheme, cognitive level and difficulty. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

correctOption.description: Which option is correct, counting from 1

tools.name: build_question_paper
tools.description: Build a draft question paper from the bank for a subject and class the caller teaches, from a blueprint: per section a question type, how many and optionally marks each; optional chapters, total marks and competency-based target (default 50%). Prefers fresh questions, spreads chapters, reports shortfalls and checks. The draft is not final until the teacher makes it final on the page. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: check_question_paper
tools.description: The checks on one of the caller's question papers (by title): total marks, share of competency-based and higher-order questions, sections, and warnings (marks mismatch, competency below target, repeats, a chapter over-weighted). Read-only.

tools.name: make_quiz_from_paper
tools.description: Turn the MCQs of one of the caller's question papers into a draft online quiz for one of their classes (same subject and grade). The quiz stays a draft; publishing it to students is the teacher's step on the Quizzes page. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: create_quiz_draft
tools.description: Create a draft online quiz for one of the teacher's classes with the multiple-choice questions they dictate (question, options, which is correct, marks). The quiz stays a draft; publishing it is the teacher's step on the Quizzes page. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: plan_syllabus_module
tools.description: Add a module (chapter or unit) to the syllabus plan of one of the teacher's classes: title, planned start and end dates, planned periods and its topics. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: get_my_cpd_hours
tools.description: The caller's continuing professional development hours this academic year against the CBSE reference of 50 (25 external, 25 in-house, by NPST area): logged entries plus in-house trainings attended, what is unverified, and what is still short. Read-only.

tools.name: log_cpd_hours
tools.description: Log hours of professional development the caller completed: title, provider, external (CBSE / government institute) or in-house, NPST area, hours, date, online or not, and a certificate link. HR or the principal verifies it later. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_staff_cpd_hours
tools.description: HR and the principal: every teacher's CPD hours this year (total, external, in-house), who has met the 50-hour reference, who is under 25, and entries waiting to be verified. Read-only.

tools.name: save_report_card_component_marks
tools.description: A subject teacher: enter a hand-entered component (e.g. notebook, subject enrichment) on one pupil's term report card for a subject they teach. An approved card goes back to draft for re-approval. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: save_co_scholastic_grades
tools.description: The class teacher: set co-scholastic grades (e.g. work education, art education, health and PE) and the discipline grade on one pupil's term report card, using the card's grade scale (e.g. A, B, C). An approved card goes back to draft. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

grades.description: Each co-scholastic area and its grade

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Competitions, olympiads, scholarships, exams, hackathons, fairs and programmes the school published that suit the caller (a student), each of a parent's own children, or a teacher's classes, with the reason ("Because Riya is in Class 9 and in the Robotics club"). Optional: this month only, a type or a domain. Dates not confirmed by the school say so. Read-only.

childName.description: A parent: which child, e.g. "Riya". Omit for all of your children (or yourself).

thisMonth.description: Only what opens or closes this month

tools.name: check_opportunity_eligibility
tools.description: "Can I enter?" for one published opportunity (named): YES, NO or CHECK with the reasons, for the caller, each of a parent's own children (or one named), or for a class / age / stream given. Read-only.

title.description: The opportunity, e.g. "science olympiad"

childName.description: A parent: which child, e.g. "Riya". Omit for all of your children (or yourself).

tools.name: save_opportunity
tools.description: Save a published opportunity (named) to the caller's list, for themselves or (a parent) for one of their own children, with deadline reminders by default (7, 3 and 1 day before a confirmed closing date; or when its usual month comes if dates are not confirmed). Needs confirmation.

title.description: The opportunity, e.g. "science olympiad"

childName.description: A parent: which child, e.g. "Riya". Omit for all of your children (or yourself).

tools.name: list_saved_opportunities
tools.description: What the caller saved (a parent: for which child), soonest confirmed deadline first, with whether reminders are on. Read-only.

tools.name: ask_teacher_about_opportunity
tools.description: A student or parent asks about a published opportunity (named): the question goes to the class teacher (and a subject teacher of that domain) in EduOS, who answers there. The teacher sees "a student / parent in Class 6 A", not a name in the notice. Needs confirmation.

childName.description: A parent: which child, e.g. "Riya". Omit for all of your children (or yourself).

tools.name: suggest_opportunity
tools.description: Staff: add an opportunity to the newsletter's review queue (an editor publishes it): title, summary, type, level, domains, classes, official https link (must be an allowed official site; a school-level item may have none), organiser and the usual months. Dates are left unconfirmed. Needs confirmation.

officialUrl.description: https://… on the organiser's official site

tools.name: get_newsletter_edition
tools.description: The latest published weekly (default) or monthly newsletter, as the caller sees it: the opening hook, the items with dates (or "check dates"), deadlines closing soon, the caller's matches with reasons, the quiz (answers hidden until taken) and the poll. Opening it counts as reading it. Read-only.

tools.name: get_newsletter_flashcards
tools.description: The caller's newsletter flashcards for a quick spoken quiz: the cards due for review today (spaced repetition across editions) and new ones from the latest editions, front and back, with the caller's streak. Ask the front, wait for the answer, then reveal the back. Marking cards known happens on the Flashcards screen. Read-only.

tools.name: answer_newsletter_quiz
tools.description: Submit the caller's answers to the latest weekly (default) or monthly edition's three-question quiz (option numbers from 1), once; the result and explanations come straight back. A student who joined the class / house board counts only towards group averages. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: draft_newsletter
tools.description: Editor: draft this week's (default) or this month's newsletter from the published opportunities: hook, items, flashcards, a three-question quiz and a poll. If a draft already exists it is kept, unless rebuild is true (a published edition is never changed). The draft is not sent: the editor reviews and publishes it on the Newsletter desk. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_newsletter_analytics
tools.description: Editor: how the newsletter is doing, per edition: delivered, emailed (and how: sent or simulated), opens in EduOS, completed, clicks to official sites, quiz participants and average, poll votes, saves and comments. No tracking pixels: opens are counted in the app only. Read-only.

tools.name: add_google_alert_feed
tools.description: Editor: add a Google Alert to the newsletter's alert feeds. Give the alert's RSS feed address (in Google Alerts: Show options → Deliver to: RSS feed → copy the RSS link; it starts https://www.google.com/alerts/feeds/), a name, and optional tags: domains, level, region, and the words the alert watches. EduOS reads it hourly; items become candidates in the review queue (nothing is published). This is Google Alerts' RSS delivery, not an API. Needs confirmation.

feedAddress.description: The Google Alerts RSS feed address, https://www.google.com/alerts/feeds/<number>/<number>

title.description: A name for the feed, e.g. "Science olympiads India"

query.description: The words the alert watches (for reference)

tools.name: get_newsletter_review_queue
tools.description: Editor: what is waiting in the newsletter review queue: how many items from staff, the starter list, approved feeds and alert feeds (Google Alerts RSS), the newest candidates with how they were extracted (AI or auto, each detail with its source text on the desk), and feed items not yet processed. Read-only.

tools.name: regenerate_newsletter_hook
tools.description: Editor: write a fresh opening hook for this week's (default) or this month's DRAFT newsletter. With an AI key it is written from the edition's published items and checked against them (otherwise the template writes another). A published edition is never changed, and nothing is sent: the editor reviews and publishes on the Newsletter desk. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_alumni_profile
tools.description: For an alumnus: their own alumni profile — batch (or served years), whether they are listed in the directory, profession, city, links and which of those they chose to show. Read-only.

tools.name: update_my_alumni_profile
tools.description: For an alumnus: change their own profession, city, links (https only), whether they are listed in the directory, and which details the directory shows. Only what is named changes. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_school_record
tools.description: For an alumnus: their own archived school record — admission number, batch, the classes and years they were enrolled, and how they left. Never marks, fees, attendance or health. Read-only.

tools.name: list_alumni_batches
tools.description: Alumni batches by passing-out year, with how many listed former students (and former staff who served that year) each has. Read-only.

tools.name: list_alumni_posts
tools.description: Posts in the caller's alumni circles (the school-wide circle and their batch or the former-staff circle): published posts, plus the caller's own posts waiting for review or returned. Read-only.

tools.name: create_alumni_post
tools.description: For an alumnus: write a post in one of their alumni circles (named, e.g. 'Class of 2019' or 'Alumni community'). It waits for the school's review before others see it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_alumni_certificate_types
tools.description: For a former student: the certificates they can request from their school record (character, study, leaving and others the school set up), with any extra details each asks for. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_alumni_certificate_requests
tools.description: For a former student: their own certificate requests and where each stands (pending, under review, approved, ready to download, rejected with the reason). Read-only.

tools.name: request_alumni_certificate
tools.description: For a former student: request a certificate (named, e.g. 'character certificate') from their own school record, saying what it is for and optionally when it is needed. It goes to the school office. Needs confirmation.

fields.description: Answers to the certificate's extra details (see list_alumni_certificate_types)

tools.name: cancel_alumni_certificate_request
tools.description: For a former student: cancel one of their own certificate requests that is still pending (named by the certificate). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_alumni_opportunities
tools.description: The alumni give-back board: published career talks, mentoring, internships, jobs, scholarships and volunteering the caller may see (students see offers for their class; external links are for adults only). Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_opportunity_offers
tools.description: For an alumnus: the offers they posted, each with its review status, the reviewer's note and how many people are interested (never who). Read-only.

tools.name: offer_opportunity
tools.description: For an alumnus: offer a career talk, mentoring, an internship, a job, a scholarship or volunteering to the school. It goes to the alumni coordinator for review before anyone sees it; students never see the alumnus's contact. Needs confirmation.

link.description: https link, shown to adults only

tools.name: withdraw_opportunity_offer
tools.description: For an alumnus: withdraw one of their own offers that is waiting for review or published (named by its title). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: express_interest_in_opportunity
tools.description: For a student or alumnus: say they are interested in a published opportunity (named by its title), with an optional line about why. The school's alumni coordinator is told and makes the introduction; nothing goes to the alumnus directly. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_planner
tools.description: For a student (or a parent, for their child): homework due and overdue, quizzes not yet taken, exam papers ahead, and a suggested study week built from the student's own homework, exam dates and published marks, sized for their age. Read-only; a suggestion, nothing is booked.

tools.name: get_board_registration_details
tools.description: For a student in Class 10 or 12 (or their parent): the details the school sends to the board in its List of Candidates — name, date of birth, gender, parents' names, subjects — flagging anything missing, with any board deadlines on the school calendar. Read-only; corrections are requested from My Profile.

tools.name: schedule_club_session
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: schedule a practice or rehearsal session on a day and time, once or weekly for up to 20 weeks, at a room or ground from the facilities list (it is booked there) or a place written out. A clash leaves that week out and says why. Members see it. Needs confirmation.

venue.description: A room or ground by name, or a place written out (default the club's home venue)

repeatWeeks.description: How many more weeks at the same time (default 0)

tools.name: cancel_club_session
tools.description: For the teacher in charge: cancel a planned club session on a day (and time), with the reason; members are told and the venue booking is released. Needs confirmation.

time.description: Its start time, when the club meets twice that day

tools.name: schedule_club_fixture
tools.description: Schedule a fixture: a match inside the school or against another school for a club or team the caller runs, or an inter-house event between named houses. Its day, start time, opponent, level and venue. The team sheet is picked on the Clubs page. Needs confirmation.

kind.description: INTERNAL within the school, EXTERNAL against other schools, HOUSE between houses

club.description: The club or team (not for a house fixture)

venue.description: A room or ground by name, or a place written out

tools.name: record_club_fixture_result
tools.description: For the teacher running a fixture that has started: record its result (a summary, won/lost/drawn/placed, and for a house event each house's position and points). The result counts only after ANOTHER teacher approves it on the Clubs page; the assistant never approves it. Needs confirmation.

fixture.description: Its title or reference, e.g. FIX-2026-0003

tools.name: cancel_club_fixture
tools.description: For the teacher running it: cancel a scheduled fixture with the reason; its venue booking is released. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: withdraw_club_membership
tools.description: For a student or parent: take the student (or the parent's child) out of a club, or withdraw a request to join that is still waiting. A freed seat goes to the waiting list. Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: For a parent with several children

tools.name: create_club
tools.description: For administration or the principal: set up a new club or team: name, category, activity, seats, when it meets and whether it takes requests to join. It needs a teacher in charge, named from the staff list; grades and the home venue are set on the Clubs page. Needs confirmation.

teacherInCharge.description: The teacher who runs it, by name

tools.name: join_ptm_waitlist
tools.description: For a parent: when a teacher has no free PTM slot left, put their child on that teacher's waiting list. If a slot frees up it is held for them and they are told; take it with accept_ptm_slot_offer. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: accept_ptm_slot_offer
tools.description: For a parent: take the PTM slot that was freed and held for their child from a teacher's waiting list, before the hold runs out. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_ptm_waitlist_entry
tools.description: For a parent: take their child off a teacher's PTM waiting list (a slot held for them goes to the next family). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: check_in_ptm_meeting
tools.description: For the teacher: check a family in for one of their own PTM meetings (from two hours before it). Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: The pupil the meeting is about

tools.name: mark_ptm_no_show
tools.description: For the teacher: mark one of their own PTM meetings as a no-show after its start time, when nobody came. Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: The pupil the meeting is about

tools.name: record_ptm_outcome
tools.description: For the teacher, after one of their own PTM meetings: record what was discussed, the actions agreed (the teacher's own become tasks with a due date; the family's are noted) and the next follow-up date. A safeguarding concern never goes here. Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: The pupil the meeting is about

dueOn.description: Needed for the teacher's own actions

nextFollowUpOn.description: When to follow up with the family

tools.name: block_ptm_slot
tools.description: For a teacher: take one of their own open, unbooked PTM slots out of use (a break, a clash), by its time (and day). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: unblock_ptm_slot
tools.description: For a teacher: reopen one of their own blocked PTM slots (offered first to a family on the waiting list). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: create_ptm_round
tools.description: For the principal or administration: set up a parent–teacher meeting round: title, days, in person or online, slot length, the classes it covers (default every class), when booking closes and the venue. It goes on the school calendar and opens for booking; teachers then add their availability. Needs confirmation.

bookingClosesOn.description: Last day families can book (default the evening before)

classes.description: Classes it covers, e.g. "Class 6 A"; default all

tools.name: update_ptm_round
tools.description: For the principal or administration: change a PTM round: its title, days, mode, slot length, booking close date, venue, or open/close it for booking. Needs confirmation.

bookingClosesOn.description: Last day families can book (default the evening before)

tools.name: cancel_ptm_round
tools.description: For the principal or administration: cancel a whole PTM round with the reason. Every family's booking in it is cancelled and they are told; it leaves the calendar. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: add_review_call_action
tools.description: Record an action agreed on a review call: what, by when, and whether the caller or the family does it. The caller's own action becomes a task on their list. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

tools.name: complete_review_call_action
tools.description: Mark an agreed action on a review call as done (its task is closed), with an optional note. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

actionTitle.description: Which action; default the only open one

tools.name: close_review_call
tools.description: Close a review call with its outcome (resolved, improving, referred, no contact, other) and a closing note; its follow-up reminder stops. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

tools.name: reopen_review_call
tools.description: Reopen a closed review call, with the reason. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

tools.name: close_conversation
tools.description: For the teacher or principal in a parent conversation: close it, with an optional closing message to the parent. Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: The child it is about

note.description: A last message to the parent

tools.name: set_conversation_office_hours
tools.description: For staff: set (or clear) the office-hours note parents see when they message the caller, e.g. "I reply on school days between 3 and 5 pm". Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_quiz_question
tools.description: Add multiple-choice questions to one of the teacher's quizzes that nobody has attempted yet (question, options, which is correct, marks). Publishing stays on the Quizzes page. Needs confirmation.

quiz.description: The quiz title; default the only draft

tools.name: update_quiz
tools.description: Change one of the teacher's quizzes: its title, instructions or time limit. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The new title

tools.name: delete_quiz
tools.description: Delete one of the teacher's quizzes that no student has attempted (one that was taken is kept; unpublish it on the Quizzes page instead). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_syllabus_module
tools.description: Change a module in one of the teacher's syllabus plans: its title, planned start or end date, description, or add topics to it. Needs confirmation.

module.description: The module as it is called now

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

title.description: The new title

tools.name: delete_syllabus_module
tools.description: Remove a module from one of the teacher's syllabus plans; a module with lessons recorded against it is kept. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: reschedule_online_class
tools.description: Change an online class the caller hosts that has not started: move it to another day or time, change its length or title. A move is announced to everyone invited. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The class as it is called now

onDate.description: Its current day, when the title repeats

tools.name: finish_online_class
tools.description: After an online class the caller hosts: mark it over, with an optional summary and a link to its recording. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_policies
tools.description: The school policies addressed to the caller's role (code, title, version, summary) and whether they have acknowledged the current version. Read-only.

tools.name: acknowledge_policy
tools.description: Record that the caller has read and accepts the current version of a school policy addressed to them (their own acknowledgement). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_trainings
tools.description: The trainings the caller is invited to (POCSO, fire safety, first aid ...): when and where, whether mandatory, their attendance and whether they have acknowledged it. Read-only.

tools.name: acknowledge_my_training
tools.description: Record that the caller has seen a training they are invited to (their own acknowledgement; attendance is marked by the organiser). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_eco_planting
tools.description: Record a planting for the greenery register: species, how many, the date, where, and the class, house or club that planted it (a teacher records only for their own team). Survival checks follow with log_plant_check. Needs confirmation.

team.description: The class, house or club that planted it

tools.name: log_correspondence
tools.description: Enter a letter in the correspondence register: an incoming letter received (from the board, a government office, a vendor ...) or an outgoing letter started as a draft, with subject, sender or addressee, their reference, how it came and a reply-by date. Dispatching and approving replies stay on the Correspondence page. Needs confirmation.

counterpartyName.description: Who it is from (incoming) or to (outgoing)

receivedOn.description: Incoming: the day it arrived (default today)

tools.name: draft_correspondence_reply
tools.description: Save a draft reply to a letter in the correspondence register that the caller owns or is assigned (or any, for the office). It stays a draft: sending it for approval, approving and dispatching happen on the Correspondence page. Use get_ai_draft first to have a letter drafted. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_compliance_obligation
tools.description: Add an obligation to the compliance register (a return, licence, disclosure, inspection ...): code, title, authority, category, how often and when next due. It starts as "under review"; deciding whether it applies and filing it stay on the Compliance page. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: draft_budget
tools.description: Draft a budget for a financial year with its lines (code, head, department, operating or capital, planned amount in rupees). It is saved as a draft; submitting it for approval and every approval stay on the Budgets page. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_library_copy_status
tools.description: For the librarian: mark a book copy (by accession number) lost, damaged, withdrawn or back on the shelf, and/or move it to a shelf, with a note. A copy on loan must be returned first. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: generate_library_accession_numbers
tools.description: For the librarian: give a title's copies accession numbers (every copy without one, or a number of new copies), optionally with a prefix and a shelf. Printing the labels is done on the Library page. Needs confirmation.

count.description: New copies; default every copy still without a number

tools.name: add_portfolio_reflection
tools.description: For a student: write a reflection in their own competency portfolio (what they learned, tried or would do differently), optionally under a competency such as communication or creativity. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_health_room_summary
tools.description: Health-room figures as counts only, for the principal and administrators: visits today and over a period (by outcome: returned to class, rested, first aid, sent home, referred), injuries, active medication plans, missed or refused doses, and first-aid stock alerts. Never names a student or says why anyone visited. Read-only.

days.description: The period in days, counting back from today (default 30; "this week" is 7)

compatibilityAliases.purpose: Redeems a proposal the pre-MCP agent stored under the old name. No new proposal is ever stored under it.
compatibilityAliases.removableWhen: No AgentAction row with tool "apply_leave" is PENDING or EXECUTING, and at least 10 minutes have passed since the first MCP deployment.

deprecated.name: record_fee_payment
deprecated.status: Not in the MCP catalog and not reachable from either channel. Recording a payment is a decision made on the Payments screen; the assistant has no tool for it. Kept only because agent.bulkAuthorization.test.js exercises its permission metadata; safe to delete together with those assertions.

blocked.reason: By design. Every tool calls an existing EduOS service; no tool accepts a query, collection, model or update document (enforced by tests/mcp.architecture.test.js).
By design. No tool accepts a URL to call or a command to run.
By design. update_student, update_ticket, update_book and update_hostel_room apply explicit field allow-lists; student.service.update() enforces its own for every caller.

Charging a family from a chat message is not something confirm-before-commit makes safe enough. Families pay through the payment link (get_payment_link). Recording, approving or refunding a fee payment is a decision made on the Payments screen: decisions.js refuses record_payment and every approve_/reject_/refund_ tool name at boot.

blocked.capability: approving, rejecting, publishing or refunding anything on the assistant's own initiative
blocked.reason: By design (assistant automation rule). The assistant drafts and the same person confirms. The few approver decisions it can record (staff leave, concessions, out-passes, bill payments, eco activities) need the approver's own words, are HIGH risk and are confirmed on the website only; publishing marks, report cards, showcase editions or a quiz, and second-person approvals (fixture results, campaigns) stay on their screens.

blocked.capability: bulk WhatsApp / email to all parents
blocked.reason: announcement.service.dispatch() still logs the email and WhatsApp fan-out rather than sending it, and Meta requires approved templates for business-initiated messages, so a tool would report a delivery that never happened. Operational notices that do go out (fee and library reminders, PTM, club and online-class notices) use messaging.sendOperational, which records SIMULATED until a provider is configured. One-to-one send_whatsapp_message exists.
No service writes Account.phoneE164 after creation; phone lives on the Account, not the Student. Would need new business logic.

Email goes out only as the system's own notices through messaging.sendOperational (EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend when configured, otherwise logged as SIMULATED). There is no free-form email to an arbitrary address from a chat.

No service; updateEnrollmentStatus() only sets one enrolment's status (exposed as update_enrollment_status). Transfer certificates are requested (request_certificate) and issued by the office (generate_certificate).

blocked.capability: file exports and downloads (accounts export, receipts, invoice and report-card PDFs, library labels)
blocked.reason: A chat has no file channel. The assistant returns the figures (get_fee_statistics, get_fee_collections, get_gst_summary, get_fee_receipt_flags) and names the page where the file is downloaded.
Only soft delete (archive_student) and irreversible anonymisation (anonymise_student) exist, both confirmed. Correct as-is.

Not needed: an older register is corrected through mark_attendance, and attendance.service accepts a date older than ATTENDANCE_BACKDATE_DAYS (default 3) only from someone holding attendance.regularize.

blocked.capability: individual pay, payroll approval and payment
blocked.reason: By design. Payroll runs can be read as totals, their inputs updated and a run calculated (tools/p4FinanceHrNurse.js); approving or paying a run, payslips and any one person's salary stay on the Payroll screen.

blocked.capability: background-verification findings and decisions; safeguarding cases
blocked.reason: By design. Verification counts are readable (get_verification_counts); findings and the final decision stay with HR and the principal on the Verification screen. Safeguarding is never handled in chat: concerns go straight to the designated lead.
By design. Connecting social or ad accounts, creating users, changing roles or permissions, domains and seat pricing would let a conversation widen its own authority; they stay on their screens.
